closed.evidence: Batch 63 PORTED (team color): 26.2 added /team modify color reset (clearColor + the reset literal + the color.clear.success lang key, which 26.1's en_us.json lacks) and replaced ColorArgument/ChatFormatting with TeamColorArgument/TeamColor (PlayerTeam.getColor became Optional). 26.1 has no reset subcommand: 'reset' is a color-argument VALUE (ColorArgument accepts RESET — it is not a format). Removed the reset literal + team.modify.color.reset executes from tree_scoreboard.rs; the scoreboard_cmd.rs color arm is set-only and stores 'reset' as no color (a fresh team's color is RESET, so the unchanged check still matches vanilla); ArgType::TeamColor now accepts 'reset' in parse (suggestions stay the 16 colors, as vanilla's getNames(true, false) lists); network.rs maps 26.1's 'minecraft:color' id (26.1's registry has no team_color); the command-parse fixture emits 'minecraft:color'. The existing teams() test (color reset clears to None) passes unchanged via the value path.

Batch 63 PORTED (large dripstone): three 26.2-only behaviours removed. (1) WindOffsetter maxOffset: 26.2 clamps the wind offset to ±(16 - radius); 26.1 applies the raw floored offset — removed max_offset + the clamp from Wind. (2) 26.1's codec has no replaceable_blocks field (26.2 added it) and 26.1's config lacks it, while the Rust REQUIRED it — now optional, defaulting to the #dripstone_replaceable_blocks tag that 26.1's DripstoneUtils.isDripstoneBase hardcodes (same tag, same contents in both jars). (3) column_radius codec bound: 26.1 is IntProviders.codec(1, 60), 26.2 narrowed it to (1, 16) — the Rust's (1,16) bound rejected 26.1's own uniform(3..19) config; now (1,60). Also verified: DripstoneUtils -> SpeleothemUtils is a rename (getDripstoneHeight == getSpeleothemHeight, same formula); place's logic is otherwise identical (the diff is lambda shape + local numbering). Speleothems (block, cluster feature, utils, tag) are a 26.2 addition absent from 26.1 entirely; the cluster code stays unreachable-per-convention (no such configured feature in either jar's data pack) and the module doc now says so.
